questions: Is the fare the same in both directions? For example, does Madina to Circle cost the same as Circle to Madina, or should each direction be entered separately?
Should only station staff be able to add routes and change fares, with a login, while passengers can only look fares up?
If there is no direct route between two stops, should the system say 'no route found', or work out a trip that combines two or more routes and add up the fares?
answers: Yes. Circle to Madina costs the same as Madina to Circle, so we keep one route for both directions and passengers can ask either way.
Say it was not found. Do not try to join two routes together; only direct routes count.
